manifest.name: dsh-dingtalk-notify
manifest.author: LapStdy
manifest.description: DSH 钉钉群通知插件：AI 需要你选择/审批、或一轮任务完成时推送到钉钉群，自带设置面板（详细度、门控、@、免打扰、诊断）。DingTalk group-robot notifications for DeepSeek Harness — ping your phone when the agent needs your input or finishes a turn, with a settings panel in the DSH UI.

bundle.text:
# dsh-dingtalk-notify profile patch layer — insert one loader entry for the
# plugin package.
#
# 宿主半区（lib/index.js）：观察 approval/question 两条 waterfall 与 session 的
# turn/end，按配置发钉钉；并注册设置面板接口 /api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/*（仅回环可写）。
#
# 浏览器半区（lib/client.js）：由 dsh-client-modules 通过 package.json 的
# dsh.client 声明（exports["./client"]）取走，在「设置 → 钉钉通知」注册整页面板，
# 并每 45 秒向宿主报一次设备心跳（手机/电脑、页面是否可见）。
# 改动客户端半区后需重启 dsh web（客户端名册在启动时扫描）。
- insert:
    - id: dingtalk-notify
      name: 'dsh-dingtalk-notify'

readme.text:
**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

一个 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 插件：**AI 需要你拍板、或一轮活干完了，往你的钉钉群推一条消息**，并附带一个装在 DSH 设置里的控制面板。

> 钉钉自定义机器人只能发不能收，所以通知里写的是「请回到 DSH 页面操作」。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LapStdy/dsh-dingtalk-notify
```

装完**重启 `dsh web`**（面板在启动时扫描名册），然后打开 **设置 → 钉钉通知**。

桌面端的配置由应用自己独占管理，**命令行装不了**（`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会直接报 `managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。要在应用界面里装：

1. 左侧栏点 **插件**
2. 点 **添加插件**
3. 粘贴 `github:LapStdy/dsh-dingtalk-notify`（也可以粘完整地址 `https://github.com/LapStdy/dsh-dingtalk-notify`），点安装
4. 装完**重启桌面端**，再打开 **设置 → 钉钉通知**

> 想改代码就先 `git clone https://github.com/LapStdy/dsh-dingtalk-notify.git`，再 `dsh plugin --profile web add "<克隆下来的目录>"`。
> 本插件是纯 JS、无构建步骤，从 GitHub 安装**不需要**额外的构建授权。

配置放在 `~/.dsh/dingtalk-notify/config.json`，**面板保存或手改文件都即时生效，不用重启**。

**运行要求**：DSH ≥ `0.1.5-rc.1`，Node ≥ 18。

readme.section: 教程：怎么让它真的发到钉钉群
readme.text: 装好插件只是一半，**消息发不发得出去，取决于钉钉那边的机器人怎么建**。照下面走一遍，大约 5 分钟。

readme.section: 第 1 步 · 在钉钉群里加一个机器人
readme.text:
1. 打开钉钉，进你想收通知的群（没有就新建一个，只有你自己的群也行）
2. 右上角 **群设置**（⋯）→ **机器人** → **添加机器人** → **自定义（通过 Webhook 接入）**
3. 起个名字（比如「DSH 通知」），点下一步

readme.section: 第 2 步 · 选安全设置（**这一步决定能不能发成功**）
readme.text:
二选一：

| 选哪种 | 怎么做 | 要注意 |
|---|---|---|
| **加签**（推荐） | 复制那串 `SEC` 开头的密钥 | 密钥要填进 DSH；换了机器人得重新复制 |
| **自定义关键词** | 填一个关键词，比如 `DSH` | 钉钉只放行**正文里含这个词**的消息；本插件标题固定带 `DSH`，所以填 `DSH` 一定过 |

勾选同意 → 完成 → **复制 Webhook 地址**（形如 `https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=...`）。

> ⚠️ Webhook 地址 + 加签密钥 = 你在这个群里的发帖凭据。别贴给别人，更别提交到 GitHub。

readme.section: 第 3 步 · 填进 DSH 并测通
readme.text:
打开 **设置 → 钉钉通知**：

1. **Webhook 地址**：粘贴第 2 步复制的地址（原来那条只显示尾巴，直接粘新的就会替换）
2. **加签密钥**：用加签模式就粘 `SEC...`；用关键词模式留空
3. 点 **发送测试消息** —— 这一下**不受门控限制，永远真发**

群里收到，链路就通了。

readme.section: 第 5 步 · 没收到？按这个顺序查
readme.text:
| 现象 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 面板提示 **发送失败 `310000`** | 关键词或加签不匹配，最常见的坑。改成「自定义关键词」并填 `DSH` 最省事 |
| 面板提示 **已跳过** | 这不是失败：当时有人正看着 DSH 页面 / 手机不在线 / 处在免打扰时段。点「发送测试消息」可绕过门控单独验证链路 |
| 面板提示 **还没填 Webhook** | 地址没存上，回第 3 步重来 |
| 钉钉里没人被 @ | 机器人只会往群里发消息，要 @ 谁得在「高级」里填手机号 |
| 只有完成通知、没有选择通知 | 那个问题可能被 `dsh-auto-review` 之类的回答者直接接走了，诊断区里有记录 |

| 时机 | 钉钉里收到 |
|---|---|
| AI 让你选择（含计划审批） | 🔔 DSH 需要你选择 |
| 某个操作被拦下要你批准 | 🔐 DSH 需要你审批 |
| 一轮任务结束 | ✅ 任务完成 / ❌ 出错 / ⏹ 已中断 |

每一项都能单独关掉。默认「干活不足 5 秒的轮次不发」，避免刷屏。

插件只**旁观**、不抢答：发完通知立刻放行，弹窗和自动审批照旧工作；发送失败只写日志，绝不影响 AI 干活。

每个打开的 DSH 页面每 45 秒报到一次，宿主持有一张在线设备表：

| 模式 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `away`（默认） | 有人正看着 DSH 页面就不发；人走开、或只有手机在看时才发 |
| `mobileOnly` | 只有手机端在线时才发，否则静默 |
| `always` | 总是发 |

手机浏览器锁屏后会暂停计时器、心跳会断，所以心跳有效期默认 5 分钟。想要「离开电脑才通知我」，用 `away` 更可靠。

面板里二选一，右下方就是实时预览：

| 简洁 | 详细 |
|---|---|
|  |  |

**简洁**只发一句话 + 会话名，一眼扫完；**详细**会带上问题正文、选项、工具名、用时和回复摘要。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `webhook` | `""` | 机器人 Webhook 地址（必填） |
| `secret` | `""` | 加签密钥 `SECxxx`；用「自定义关键词」模式则留空 |
| `detailLevel` | `detailed` | `brief` 简洁（一句话）/ `detailed` 详细（问题正文、选项、工具名、用时） |
| `gating` | `away` | `away` / `mobileOnly` / `always` |
| `presenceTtlSeconds` | `300` | 心跳有效期（60–3600 秒） |
| `notifyOnQuestion` | `true` | 需要你选择时通知 |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | 需要你审批时通知 |
| `notifyOnTurnEnd` | `true` | 任务完成时通知 |
| `notifyOnError` | `true` | 轮次失败时通知 |
| `notifyOnAbort` | `false` | 轮次被中断时通知 |
| `minTurnSeconds` | `5` | 短于此秒数的轮次不发；`0` = 每轮都发 |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | 子任务的轮次也发 |
| `atMobiles` | `[]` | 要 @ 的手机号（正文会自动补 `@手机号` 文本，否则钉钉不会真的 @） |
| `atAll` | `false` | @ 所有人 |
| `dndEnabled` | `false` | 免打扰时段开关 |
| `dndFrom` / `dndTo` | `23:30` / `07:30` | 免打扰区间，可跨零点 |
| `dndExceptErrors` | `true` | 免打扰时段内出错仍通知 |
| `mergeWindowSeconds` | `3` | 同一轮同类提醒合并窗口；`0` = 不合并 |
| `retryOnFail` | `true` | 失败自动重试一次；被限流则冷却 60 秒 |
| `maxMessagesPerMinute` | `18` | 每分钟上限（钉钉官方 20） |
发送诊断日志：`~/.dsh/dingtalk-notify/log.ndjson`，每行一条 JSON（`sent` / `skip` / `error`）。面板的「诊断」区也能看最近 20 条决策和跳过原因。

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/config` | 读脱敏配置 + 当前门控判定 |
| POST | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/config` | 写配置（`null` 表示清除该键） |
| POST | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/test` | 发一条测试消息 |
| POST | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/presence` | 设备心跳 |
| GET | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/status` | 在线设备 + 发送历史 |
| POST | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/log` | `{action:"clear"}` 清空内存历史 |

除 `presence` 外均为**仅回环**可访问；`presence` 只写在线表、不读配置。加签密钥**永不回传浏览器**，只显示是否已配置。

所有 POST 接口都要求 `Content-Type: application/json`，并拒绝浏览器标记为 `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` 的跨站请求（403）。这样任意网页都没法借你的浏览器改 Webhook 或伪造“手机正在看页面”——纯文本/表单请求会得到 415。用 `curl` 手调接口时记得加 `-H "Content-Type: application/json"`。

> ⚠ **回环守卫只防浏览器跨站，不防“把 DSH 代理到局域网”。** 如果你用 dsh-pocket 等工具把 DSH 暴露到局域网，而代理没开登录认证（例如 `lanAuthEnabled=false`），局域网里任何设备都能访问这些接口，包括改 Webhook。请给代理打开认证、限制监听地址，或用防火墙挡住代理端口。

```powershell
node bin/selftest.mjs         # 配置读写 / 掩码 / 门控 / 消息组装 / 浏览器半区，不发消息
node bin/smoke-test.mjs --dry # 桩上下文加载插件，验监听器与面板接口
node bin/dingtalk-test.mjs    # 真发一条自检消息到群里
```

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-dingtalk-notify
```

临时安静：面板关「总开关」，或把 `config.json` 的 `enabled` 改成 `false`。

改了 `lib/` 下任何文件（宿主半区 `index.js`、浏览器半区 `client.js`）都要**重启 `dsh web`** 才生效——运行中的进程不重载插件源码。

| 现象 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| 设置里没有「钉钉通知」 | 没重启 `dsh web`；面板名册在启动时扫描 |
| 面板顶部红字「配置文件读不出来」 | `config.json` 不是合法 JSON（BOM、尾逗号、编辑器半写）。损坏文件已备份成同目录的 `config.corrupt-<时间戳>.json`；修好或删除原文件后再保存（保存会被拒绝，避免覆盖其他设置） |
| 钉钉没收到，面板显示「已跳过」 | 看跳过原因：有人正看着页面 / 手机不在线 / 免打扰 / 没填 Webhook / 配置文件读不出来 |
| 面板显示「发送失败」 | 错误码已翻译成人话；`310000` = 关键词或加签不匹配；提示「网络请求超时」= 10 秒内没连上钉钉，已自动重试一次 |
| 只有完成通知、没有选择通知 | 问题可能被 `dsh-auto-review` 之类的回答者直接接走了，诊断区有记录 |

[中文](README.md) | **English**

A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin: **ping your DingTalk group when the agent needs your input, or when a turn finishes**, plus a settings panel inside the DSH UI.

> DingTalk custom robots are one-way — they can only send. That is why the notification says "come back to the DSH page to act".

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LapStdy/dsh-dingtalk-notify
```

Then **restart `dsh web`** (the panel roster is scanned at startup) and open **Settings → DingTalk Notify**.

The desktop app owns its profile exclusively, so **the CLI cannot install into it** (`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` fails with `managed exclusively by the Electron application`). Install from inside the app:

1. Click **Plugins** in the sidebar
2. Click **Add plugin**
3. Paste `github:LapStdy/dsh-dingtalk-notify` (or the full URL `https://github.com/LapStdy/dsh-dingtalk-notify`) and install
4. **Restart the desktop app**, then open **Settings → DingTalk Notify**

> To hack on the code, `git clone https://github.com/LapStdy/dsh-dingtalk-notify.git` first, then `dsh plugin --profile web add "<the cloned directory>"`.
> The plugin is plain JS with no build step, so installing from GitHub needs **no** build authorization.

Config lives at `~/.dsh/dingtalk-notify/config.json`. **Saving from the panel or editing the file both take effect immediately — no restart.**

**Requirements**: DSH ≥ `0.1.5-rc.1`, Node ≥ 18.

readme.section: Tutorial: making messages actually reach your DingTalk group
readme.text: Installing the plugin is only half of it — **whether a message gets through depends on how the robot is set up on the DingTalk side.** Five minutes, start to finish.

readme.section: Step 1 · Add a robot to a DingTalk group
readme.text:
1. Open DingTalk and go to the group you want notifications in (create one — a group with only you works fine)
2. **Group settings** (⋯) → **Robots** → **Add robot** → **Custom (via Webhook)**
3. Give it a name (e.g. "DSH Notify") and continue

readme.section: Step 2 · Pick a security setting (**this decides whether sending works at all**)
readme.text:
Choose one:

| Option | What to do | Watch out for |
|---|---|---|
| **Signed** (recommended) | Copy the `SEC...` secret | Paste it into DSH; re-copy if you rebuild the robot |
| **Custom keyword** | Enter a keyword, e.g. `DSH` | DingTalk only delivers messages whose **body contains that word**; this plugin's title always contains `DSH`, so `DSH` always matches |

Accept, finish, then **copy the Webhook URL** (`https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=...`).

readme.section: Step 2 · Pick a security setting (**this decides whether sending works at all**)
readme.text: > ⚠️ The Webhook URL and signing secret are posting credentials for that group. Do not share them, and never commit them to GitHub.

readme.section: Step 3 · Paste into DSH and verify
readme.text:
Open **Settings → DingTalk Notify**:

1. **Webhook URL**: paste the URL from step 2 (the stored one is shown masked; pasting a new value replaces it)
2. **Signing secret**: paste `SEC...` for signed mode, or leave empty for keyword mode
3. Click **Send test message** — it **ignores gating and always really sends**

If the group receives it, the chain works.

readme.section: Step 5 · Nothing arrived? Check in this order
readme.text:
| Symptom | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Panel shows **send failed `310000`** | Keyword or signature mismatch — the most common trap. Switching to "custom keyword" with `DSH` is the easy fix |
| Panel shows **skipped** | Not a failure: someone was watching the DSH page / no phone online / inside the do-not-disturb window. **Send test message** bypasses gating to verify the chain on its own |
| Panel shows **no Webhook yet** | The URL did not save — redo step 3 |
| Nobody got @-mentioned | The robot only posts to the group; to @ someone, add their number under Advanced |
| Completion notices arrive but question notices do not | Something like `dsh-auto-review` may have answered the question directly; the diagnostics list has a record |

| When | What lands in DingTalk |
|---|---|
| The agent asks you to choose (including plan review) | 🔔 DSH needs your input |
| An action is blocked pending your approval | 🔐 DSH needs your approval |
| A turn ends | ✅ Done / ❌ Failed / ⏹ Aborted |

Every trigger can be turned off individually. Turns shorter than 5 seconds are skipped by default, to avoid spam.
The plugin only **observes** — it never answers for you: it calls the next handler immediately, so popups and auto-approval keep working. A failed send is only logged; it never breaks the agent.

Every open DSH page reports in once every 45 seconds, so the host keeps a table of online devices:

| Mode | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `away` (default) | Stay quiet while someone is looking at the DSH page; send when they step away or only the phone is watching |
| `mobileOnly` | Send only while a phone is online, otherwise stay quiet |
| `always` | Always send |
A phone browser pauses its timers when locked, so heartbeats stop; the heartbeat TTL defaults to 5 minutes. If you want "notify me when I leave the desk", `away` is the more reliable choice.

readme.section: What the message looks like (detail level)
readme.text:
Pick one in the panel — the preview updates live:

| Brief | Detailed |
|---|---|
|  |  |

**Brief** sends one line plus the session name; **detailed** adds the question body, options, tool name, duration and a reply summary.
`~/.dsh/dingtalk-notify/config.json` — a commented template is generated on first start:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `webhook` | `""` | Robot Webhook URL (required) |
| `secret` | `""` | Signing secret `SEC...`; leave empty for "keyword" mode |
| `detailLevel` | `detailed` | `brief` (one line) / `detailed` (question body, options, tool name, duration) |
| `gating` | `away` | `away` / `mobileOnly` / `always` |
| `presenceTtlSeconds` | `300` | Heartbeat TTL (60–3600 s) |
| `notifyOnQuestion` | `true` | Notify when the agent asks you to choose |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | Notify when an approval is pending |
| `notifyOnTurnEnd` | `true` | Notify when a turn completes |
| `notifyOnError` | `true` | Notify when a turn fails |
| `notifyOnAbort` | `false` | Notify when a turn is aborted |
| `minTurnSeconds` | `5` | Skip turns shorter than this; `0` = every turn |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | Also notify for subagent turns |
| `atMobiles` | `[]` | Phone numbers to @ (the body gets an `@number` text, otherwise DingTalk will not really @ them) |
| `atAll` | `false` | @ everyone |
| `dndEnabled` | `false` | Do-not-disturb window switch |
| `dndFrom` / `dndTo` | `23:30` / `07:30` | Do-not-disturb window, may cross mid
Send log: `~/.dsh/dingtalk-notify/log.ndjson`, one JSON object per line (`sent` / `skip` / `error`). The **Diagnostics** section of the panel shows the last 20 decisions with skip reasons.

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/config` | Masked config + current gating verdict |
| POST | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/config` | Write config (`null` clears a key) |
| POST | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/test` | Send one test message |
| POST | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/presence` | Device heartbeat |
| GET | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/status` | Online devices + send history |
| POST | `/api/dsh-dingtalk-notify/log` | `{action:"clear"}` clears in-memory history |
All routes except `presence` are **loopback-only**; `presence` writes the online table and never reads config. The signing secret is **never sent back to the browser** — only whether it is set.

Every POST route requires `Content-Type: application/json` and rejects browser requests marked `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` with 403. A plain-text/form cross-site request gets 415, so an arbitrary web page cannot rewrite your webhook or fake “the phone is watching”. When calling the API with `curl`, add `-H "Content-Type: application/json"`.

> ⚠ **The loopback guard only stops cross-site browser requests — it does not protect a DSH proxied onto your LAN.** If you expose DSH through something like dsh-pocket with LAN authentication disabled (`lanAuthEnabled=false`), every device on the LAN can reach these routes, including the one that rewrites the webhook. Enable authentication on the proxy, restrict its bind address, or firewall its port.

```powershell
node bin/selftest.mjs         # config I/O, masking, gating, message assembly, client half — sends nothing
node bin/smoke-test.mjs --dry # load the plugin against a stub context, check listeners and panel routes
node bin/dingtalk-test.mjs    # really send one test message to your group
```

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-dingtalk-notify
```

To mute temporarily: turn off the master switch in the panel, or set `enabled` to `false` in `config.json`.

Any change under `lib/` (host half `index.js`, client half `client.js`) needs a **`dsh web` restart** — a running process does not reload plugin source.

| Symptom | Cause |
|---|---|
| No "DingTalk Notify" in Settings | `dsh web` was not restarted; the panel roster is scanned at startup |
| Red banner "config file cannot be read" | `config.json` is not valid JSON (BOM, trailing comma, half-written file). The broken file is backed up as `config.corrupt-<timestamp>.json`; fix or delete the original before saving (saving is refused so other keys are not overwritten) |
| Nothing arrived, panel says "skipped" | Read the skip reason: someone is looking at the page / no phone online / do-not-disturb / no Webhook / config file cannot be read |
| Panel says "send failed" | Error codes are translated into plain language; `310000` = keyword or signature mismatch; "network request timed out" = DingTalk did not answer within 10 s and one retry already happened |
| Only completion notices, no question notices | The question may have been answered directly by something like `dsh-auto-review`; the diagnostics list has a record |
